newsitem.title: USA: Campo Q2 shr loss $2.59 after charge.
newsitem.headline: Campo Q2 shr loss $2.59 after charge.

text.p: Campo Electronics Appliances and Computers Inc on Wednesday reported a second quarter loss of $14.4 million, or $2.59 per share, after charges totaling about $16.7 million.

The company said the charges included about $6.7 million for previously announced store closures and an increase to reserve for a previously closed store, about $2.6 million for strategic changes and a charge for a deferred tax valuation allowance of $7.4 million, which resulted in an income tax expense of about $3.2 million.
Net loss for the six month period ended February 28, 1997 including the charges was $15.2 million, or $2.73 a share, the company said.
Campo said that excluding the charges, net loss for the three and six months would have been $1.2 million, or $0.22 a share, and $2.0 million, or $0.36 a share, respectively.
Year-ago figures for the company were not immediately available.
